scripts.dev:services: npx concurrently -n gateway,orders,products,auth,realtime,worker -c auto "npm run dev -w @inventory/gateway" "npm run dev -w @inventory/orders-service" "npm run dev -w @inventory/products-service" "npm run dev -w @inventory/auth-service" "npm run dev -w @inventory/realtime" "npm run dev -w @inventory/worker"
scripts.build: npm run wasm:build && npm run build -w @inventory/web && npm run build -w @inventory/products
scripts.lint: node ./node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p packages/domain/tsconfig.json --noEmit && node ./node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p packages/db/tsconfig.json --noEmit && node ./node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p apps/web/tsconfig.json --noEmit && node ./node_modules/eslint/bin/eslint.js packages apps/web/src apps/products/src services --max-warnings=0
